align_camera_extrinsics: align source camera extrinsics to target camera extrinsics using OpenCV convention
apply_transformation: apply rotation, translation, and scale transformation to source camera extrinsics
align_and_transform_cameras_PT3D: align and transform source cameras using PyTorch3D convention with given alignment parameters
random_rotation_matrix: generate random orthogonal rotation matrices using QR decomposition
test_align_camera_extrinsics: test camera alignment by generating random transformations and verifying round-trip accuracy
